prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1234; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the force of the collision and with the clinical presentation. Over the course of 23 visits, care included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, progressing in a typical pattern for cervical strain. Visit frequency decreased as symptoms improved and the patient reported steady functional gains. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted cervical rotation that support the diagnosis, while neurological screening and motor testing were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment to the cervical spine is known to this provider. Note that two similar billing entries dated to the same day are currently under review for accuracy and are not yet resolved. Patient is discharged from active care with instructions to continue home exercises and return if symptoms recur.
